description: This is a Go source file containing unit tests for the DevService implementation in a package related to development mode management. The tests verify functionalities such as checking for config files, port management, environment variable loading, and more.

methods.name: TestNewDevService
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new DevService instance and verifies its components.

methods.name: TestRunInDevMode_NoAgentfieldYaml
methods.description: Checks behavior when agentfield.yaml does not exist in the directory.

methods.name: TestRunInDevMode_AgentfieldYamlExists
methods.description: Verifies processing when agentfield.yaml exists, anticipating startup errors rather than missing config issues.

methods.name: TestStopDevMode_NotImplemented
methods.description: Ensures the StopDevMode method returns an unimplemented error.

methods.name: TestGetDevStatus_NotImplemented
methods.description: Ensures the GetDevStatus method returns an unimplemented error.

methods.name: TestGetFreePort
methods.description: Validates that the service finds a free port within a specified range.

methods.name: TestGetFreePort_NoPortAvailable
methods.description: Checks behavior when no free port can be found.

methods.name: TestIsPortAvailable_Available
methods.description: Tests port availability detection when port is free.

methods.name: TestIsPortAvailable_NotAvailable
methods.description: Tests port availability detection when port is occupied.

methods.name: TestDiscoverAgentPort_Success
methods.description: Placeholder test for agent port discovery logic.

methods.name: TestWaitForAgent_Success
methods.description: Placeholder test for waiting on agent startup.

methods.name: TestLoadDevEnvFile
methods.description: Tests proper loading and parsing of environment variables from a .env file.

methods.name: TestLoadDevEnvFile_FileNotFound
methods.description: Checks error handling when the .env file is missing.

methods.name: TestLoadDevEnvFile_InvalidFormat
methods.description: Verifies that invalid lines in the .env file are skipped and valid ones are parsed correctly.
